title: People's Light & Theatre

services.name: Costume Rentals
services.desc: The costumes created by People’s Light professional artisans are now available to rent through our online database. The costume shop maintains a collection of over 10,000 pieces, ranging from costumes, accessories, and footwear in styles from Medieval to Modern. The collection of costumes is available for professional rentals to film, theatres, schools, and other non-profit events. Once you have found something you would like to rent, make note of the item code and use the rental forms below to submit your request. The database is just for browsing the items we have in stock. blurb: Auditions are not what they used to be. Technology and evolving casting systems have transformed the audition process, from professional calls to college admissions. People’s Light Company Artist Madeleine Garcia is well versed in the most up to date tools, techniques and unwritten expectations of this brave new digital world.
